name: docs_get_toc
description: Show the table of contents of a Siemens documentation publication, or of the subtree under a topic: an indented outline with one title and reference per line. Pass a compact reference (<prefix>:<mapId> or <prefix>:<mapId>/<contentId>; prefixes tia=docs.tia.siemens.cloud, iox=docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud) or a reader URL copied from a tool result or the browser. Results use compact references by default; set reference_format='url' for reader URLs.

url.description: Publication or topic reference, or a reader URL. Pass a compact reference (<prefix>:<mapId> or <prefix>:<mapId>/<contentId>; prefixes tia=docs.tia.siemens.cloud, iox=docs.industrial-operations-x.siemens.cloud) or a reader URL copied from a tool result or the browser.

reference_format.description: 'compact' (default) for short references or 'url' for full reader URLs.
